objective: Measured improvement over native PERO word boxes, frontier-quality image-grounded transcription, evidence-backed OLR/metadata/retrieval and coherent ALTO/METS exports

model_policy.rule: Use one primary reader; call a stronger model only on explicit uncertainty, structural failure, glyph-convention risk or unresolved disagreement. Do not run all three models routinely.

geometry_experiment.inputs: Same reference text, polygons and baselines for all geometry methods. Word boxes withheld from construction, used only by evaluator.
geometry_experiment.baseline: pero-ocr 0.7.0 native ALTO exporter, public eu/cz print-newspapers model 2022-09-26, CPU
geometry_experiment.candidate_family: Constrained foreground refinement of native aligned boxes, calibrated on development only
geometry_experiment.selection: Choose on development mean IoU subject to no increase in p95 horizontal-boundary error or missing-word rate
geometry_experiment.heldout_gate: Higher mean IoU on each heldout page, no worse p95 horizontal-boundary error and no additional missing words. Report p99/worst and conventions separately.
geometry_experiment.scope_warning: Passing this small conditional benchmark is not an end-to-end or cross-domain superiority claim. After inspecting heldout scores, never retune on those same pages and call them unseen.

stop_policy: Do not declare success until every gate has independent evidence. Checkpoint after each experiment; if resources or evidence are unavailable, record the precise blocker and retain pending work.
reference_warning: 2026-09-27: a fixed-seed blind sample of 45 French lines found Luna and PERO mutually closer than either to the distributed transcription on 24/45 lines (triage only, not truth). A model-independent structural scan found 121 C1 controls and 60 lines containing locally reversible UTF-8-as-Latin-1 mojibake. Scores measure agreement with noisy distributed annotations, not certified truth. Originals remain unchanged; independent human adjudication is required.
